samples.subject: Scheduled Network Upgrade Notification - July 15
samples.body:
Dear Users,

As part of our ongoing efforts to improve network performance, a scheduled upgrade will occur on July 15th from 1:00 AM to 4:00 AM UTC. During this window, some network services may experience brief interruptions.

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

Regards,
Network Engineering Team
network-team@enterprise.org

samples.subject: Upcoming Network Upgrade Scheduled for July 5
samples.body:
Dear All,

As part of our ongoing infrastructure improvement plan, a network upgrade is scheduled for July 5th, starting at 1:00 AM UTC and lasting approximately 4 hours.

During this window, some internal services may experience brief interruptions.

Please plan accordingly and report any issues to the IT Helpdesk at it-helpdesk@organization.com.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Regards,
Network Engineering Team
